propositions: tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON object in a model reply, causing schema-valid decoys (tool results, examples, dependency links) to be selected over the real payload appearing later
Five recurrences of the same defect class persist across model swaps because the extraction logic is schema-blind and does not validate that candidate JSON conforms to the expected output contract
The hardened prompted path uses schema-filtered candidate selection with last-valid-wins semantics to ensure the correct contract object is parsed from replies containing multiple JSON objects

Provider-native structured output (Bedrock outputConfig) is deployed only for model cells where thinking-compatibility has been measured as safe, while unmeasured cells remain on the hardened prompted path
An explicit sentinel output channel directive whose extraction is shipped atomically ensures prompted structured replies are unambiguous and measurable before/after through raw-output artifacts
